title: Get to know System: Alerts Configuration, Alert Categories and more
summary: Tour of Alerts Configuration, Alert Categories, Alert Rules and Alert Templates: what each screen is for.

steps.title: System
steps.details: We'll go through Alerts Configuration, Alert Categories, Alert Rules and Alert Templates.

steps.title: Alerts Configuration
steps.details: Schedules and parameters the alerts engine runs with. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Alert Categories
steps.details: They group alerts (collections, reminders, follow-up) to filter and prioritize them. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Alert Rules
steps.details: They define when the system creates an alert (debt, inactive patient, unconfirmed appointment) and whether it's sent automatically by email or WhatsApp. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Alert Templates
steps.details: Email and WhatsApp texts used by alerts and reminders. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
